about_the_game:
My Bimbo Dream – Bonus Content Pack

This DLC adds extra material for fans who want more from the world of My Bimbo Dream.

📚 Bonus Comics

Includes the Alien Abduction comic—an off-canon fantasy featuring Sue and Randall caught in a transformation-heavy sci-fi scenario—as well as the Seasonal Comic, exploring themed stories outside the main game.

📘 Official Walkthrough

A detailed guide to the main game routes, helping you explore every scene, choice, and outcome across all three paths: Harem, Pimp, and NTR.

🎁 Supporter Gifts

Includes previously exclusive content: wallpapers, special renders—originally available only to early supporters. Perfect for fans who want to collect and enjoy every extra.

content_descriptors.notes: The comic includes explicit sexual content, nudity, adult language, and themes of domination, bimbofication, power dynamics and Rough sex!
